title: Provide order cancellation
goal: A user can cancel an order before shipping begins.
verification: Cancellation succeeds before shipping and is rejected after shipping begins.

steps.title: Implement the cancellation policy
steps.objective: The system can decide whether an order is cancellable from its shipping state.
work: Implement the domain behavior that evaluates cancellation eligibility.
verification: Orders before shipping are cancellable and orders after shipping are not.
